annotations.title: Say the next thing on a call

description: Say the next thing on a call you started. Returns their answer. If they ask where to reach you, say your line's address or name here: they see it by caller ID, but say it anyway. Never the secret.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

to.description: Who to reach: a domain like @example.com, a name like @sally, or a 64-character private address.

name: say
